```javascript
function doubleEvens(numbers) {
  // Filter keeps only even numbers, then doubles them
  return numbers.filter(n => n % 2 === 0).map(n => n * 2);
}

// Result for [1, 2, 3, 4]
console.log(doubleEvens([1, 2, 3, 4])); 
// Output: [2, 4, 6, 8]
